issuing_body: Minnesota Attorney General, Medicaid Fraud Control Unit
title: Attorney General Ellison announces criminal charges involving over $1.5 million in Medicaid fraud
supports: Salman Ahmed Elmi was charged with eight felony theft offenses related to Reva Health and more than $1 million in Medicaid-funded ARMHS services alleged to have been unprovided or ineligible.
The Reva Health allegations include falsified documentation, recipient kickbacks, use of ineligible providers, and claims of supervision the AG says was inadequate.
Mohamed Haji Rashid was charged with nine felony theft offenses related to Liberty Home Health Care and more than $300,000 in Medicaid-funded services alleged to have been unprovided or ineligible.
The AG says Liberty billed PCA services not provided on more than 3,300 occasions.
The AG describes the Elmi and Rashid matters as separate and independent cases.

does_not_support: Charges are allegations and do not establish guilt.
Do not merge the two cases into one conspiracy.
Do not add the AG's combined headline amount to the two component allegations as a separate loss.
